description:
Approved 2026-09-28 (proposal https://claude.ai/artifact/KX4zrM7YzBAhGr42RJoYzx, also ../fz-extern-no-body.html).

Why: after fz-xxd.3 an extern's declaration is resolved once, by DeriveFunctionContract, but LowerFunction still runs per lowered extern only to package LoweredBody::Extern { LoweredExtern } from the surface + contract (jobs/body.rs:1210-1215, 1299-1348, 349-430). Two jobs where one does; it is why .3 raised the 00181/00420/00567/00571 pins.

Design: derive_function_contract also builds the extern's wire ABI (abi, symbol, variadic, params, ret), using resolve_extern_signature/resolve_extern_abi/extern_abi_error/extern_wire_ty/extern_param_wire/extern_return_wire moved unchanged from jobs/body.rs to jobs/contract.rs; a refused ABI is refused there as a diagnostic. An extern has no LoweredBody: wire-ABI readers (backend.rs:617, native.rs:129/242/4895, artifact.rs:1226, transport.rs:607/1647/1658/1990, runtime_demand.rs:1169) read it from the contract; body-existence readers (keying.rs:61-65/97-131/187, semantic.rs:2037, executable_facts.rs) answer 'no body' from the surface or read the contract's arity. Not adopted: keeping LoweredBody::Extern with a second producer.

Removal ledger: LoweredBody::Extern and every extern match arm; the extern branch of lower(); the FunctionContract gate in lower_function_gates added by .3; the extern contract read in lower_function (body.rs:268-276); one LowerFunction job per lowered extern.

Prediction: every pin falls by exactly one job per lowered extern; bounds 00181 <= 282, 00420 census <= 2743, 00567 <= 735, 00571 <= 1152. Builder measures the exact extern LowerFunction count per fixture first and states exact predictions before building. No pin may rise.

Done when: all doors green (variadic, c_int, resource, spec/violation fixtures included), full gate green, every moved pin a drop with its mechanism.
title: An extern has no body: its contract job builds its wire ABI
